about: Citizen Solar Ltd, formerly Citizen Infoline Ltd, manufactures solar PV modules from two facilities at Kadi, Gujarat and markets solar inverters, with transportation and solar installation/maintenance forming ancillary revenue. Citizen Solar Pvt Ltd was amalgamated into the listed entity with April 1, 2023 as the appointed date; NCLT sanctioned the scheme on March 19, 2026, after which the company was renamed Citizen
